title: Integrate Razorpay (INR payments) and Google AdSense (real ad revenue)

requirements.text: Add Razorpay payment gateway integration to the backend to support INR-based premium subscriptions for Indian users. Store Razorpay key ID and secret in canister state (similar to existing Stripe config). Expose backend methods: setRazorpayConfiguration(keyId, keySecret), isRazorpayConfigured(), createRazorpayOrder(amount in paise, currency 'INR'), and verifyRazorpayPayment(orderId, paymentId, signature) that validates the HMAC-SHA256 signature and upgrades the caller's subscription to premium on success.
acceptanceCriteria: Razorpay key ID and secret can be stored and retrieved from canister state
isRazorpayConfigured() returns true only when both key ID and secret are set
createRazorpayOrder() returns an order ID that can be used on the frontend
verifyRazorpayPayment() validates the payment signature and upgrades subscription to premium on success
Existing Stripe integration remains unaffected

requirements.text: Add a Razorpay setup modal component (similar to the existing StripeSetupModal) that allows the admin/owner to enter their Razorpay Key ID and Key Secret. Wire it into the Settings page with a dedicated 'Razorpay Setup' button visible only to authenticated users. Add corresponding useRazorpayConfig and useSetRazorpayConfiguration hooks mirroring the existing useStripeConfig pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Razorpay Setup' button appears in the Settings page for authenticated users
Clicking it opens a modal with fields for Key ID and Key Secret
Submitting the form calls the backend setRazorpayConfiguration method
A success toast is shown on save
useRazorpayConfig hook correctly reflects whether Razorpay is configured

requirements.text: Update the Upgrade page (frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx) to display a Razorpay payment option for INR (₹) alongside the existing Stripe option. When the user selects Razorpay checkout, call the backend to create a Razorpay order, load the Razorpay JS SDK (https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js) dynamically, open the Razorpay checkout modal, and on successful payment call the backend verifyRazorpayPayment method. On verified success, redirect to the existing PaymentSuccess page. On failure, redirect to PaymentFailure page.
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrade page shows a Razorpay payment button labeled with INR pricing (e.g., ₹499/month)
Razorpay checkout modal opens with correct order details
On payment success the signature is verified via backend before redirecting to PaymentSuccess
On payment failure or dismissal the user is redirected to PaymentFailure page
Razorpay option is only shown when isRazorpayConfigured() returns true

requirements.text: Add Google AdSense integration support to the app. Add a backend method setAdSensePublisherId(publisherId: Text) to store the AdSense publisher ID (ca-pub-XXXXXXXX) in canister state, and getAdSensePublisherId() to retrieve it. The publisher ID should be included in a metadata endpoint or accessible from the frontend configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: setAdSensePublisherId() stores the publisher ID in stable canister state
getAdSensePublisherId() returns the stored publisher ID
Publisher ID persists across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Add an AdSense configuration section to the Settings page where the authenticated user can enter and save their Google AdSense Publisher ID (ca-pub-XXXXXXXX). Add a useAdSenseConfig hook to read and update the publisher ID. Dynamically inject the Google AdSense script tag (<script async src='https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-XXXX'>) into the page head when a publisher ID is configured. Add AdSense ad unit placeholders (ins.adsbygoogle) in appropriate locations: below the video player in VideoPlayer.tsx and in the sidebar area in Layout.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page has an 'AdSense Configuration' section with a Publisher ID input field
Saving the publisher ID calls the backend setAdSensePublisherId method
When a publisher ID is configured, the AdSense script is injected into the document head
Ad unit placeholders (ins.adsbygoogle) are rendered below the video player
Ad unit placeholders are rendered in a sidebar slot in the main layout
adsbygoogle.push({}) is called after each ad unit renders

constraints: Do not remove or break existing Stripe subscription integration
Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Razorpay JS SDK must be loaded dynamically at checkout time, not bundled
AdSense publisher ID must be stored in stable canister state so it survives upgrades
nonGoals: Removing or replacing Stripe — both Stripe and Razorpay should coexist
Automatic ad placement optimization or A/B testing
Real-time revenue analytics from AdSense (only integration/script injection is in scope)
SMS or email notifications for payment events
Razorpay subscriptions/recurring billing (one-time premium upgrade only)
